args.text: Hi June, approval request from assistant. Kwame Adjei-Rowe (Coastal, owner of Driftmoor Marine Freight) wants to send Bettina Kroll (Coastal team lead, internal) a mail stating the Driftmoor 2027 renewal rate of $1,480 per seat for her coverage plan. Bettina is not on the list of people who can see finance figures, so this needs your approval (or Anselm Grieve's). Kwame's draft is saved with the figure held out. Reply approve or decline and I will record it. Nothing has been sent.

Kwame, I've saved the draft to Bettina, but I've left the rate out of it for now and haven't sent anything.

**Why:** The $1,480 per-seat rate is a finance figure. Under our rules it can go only to Anselm Grieve, June Osei-Lark, and the account owner. Bettina is none of those, so the rate needs approval first. Owning Driftmoor doesn't cover sending it to her.

**What I did:**
- **Draft:** It's in your drafts, addressed to Bettina Kroll (bkroll@pemberline.com) with the subject "Driftmoor 2027 renewal rate". The rate line says "pending approval, to be inserted before sending".
- **Approval:** I logged a request with June Osei-Lark (deal desk) and sent her a DM asking her to approve or decline. Anselm could also approve.

Once June approves, I'll put the rate in the draft and tell you, and you can send it. If she declines, the draft stays as it is. If you'd rather have Anselm weigh in, tell me and I'll ask him too.
Who did Moss name as the main contact at Saltmarsh Provisions in the Coastal Sunday prep before the October 2025 handoff? I need the name and title for the account sheet.

I couldn't find that name. I checked #coastal-team, the Coastal working channel you're in, and it has no Sunday prep notes from Moss and no Saltmarsh contact name or title. Moss isn't a member of #coastal-team. The channels I can see from your side are #coastal-team, #coastal-random and #general, and Moss is in #general, which doesn't look like the right place for prep notes.

If you can tell me which channel or file the Sunday prep is in, I'll check whether you have access and read it for you. If it was sent to you directly, search your DMs or ask Moss for the contact name and title.
Yes, go ahead, Bettina can have the Driftmoor rate.

Hi Kwame, June Osei-Lark has approved sending Bettina Kroll the Driftmoor renewal rate. Your draft is still saved in your mailbox with the figure held out, so you can add it and send it yourself. I haven't changed or sent the draft.
